question:
The sentence has been divided into three parts, identify the segment which contains a spelling error in the sentence given below. Choose no error if there is no error in the sentence.

The proffessor noticed a misspelled word in the student's essay and pointed out the error during the class discussion.

options.text: the student's essay and pointed out the
The proffessor noticed a misspelled word in

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the spelling of the word "**proffessor**."
 
• The correct spelling of the word is "**professor**."
 
• It is essential to use correct spelling to ensure the clarity and professionalism of the text.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The **professor** noticed a misspelled word in the student's essay and pointed out the error during the class discussion."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "no error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is a spelling error in Option 3.
 
• **Option 2: "the student's essay and pointed out the"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "error during the class discussion."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
